notes.title: Volcano update is available on public branch
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/a13a0c74f56068bfa29046b8864a4081a19fc482.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Ahoy there, Tinkerlanders![/b][/h2][p align="justify"]It’s been half a month since we announced an unstable version of Patch 0.2.0.0, which featured the long awaited Volcano update. Thanks to all the dedicated players who helped us with testing, we’re ready to share the polished version on the main branch. [/p][p align="justify"]The update will shortly show up in your download queues! Just a brief warning – some parts of the game localization are still in the works, we’re doing our best to release the final version ASAP. For those who missed our past announcement, let us guide you through the main changes you’ll find on Tinkerlands with the Volcano update.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]VOLCANO UPDATE FEATURES [/b][/h1][h2][b]Mod Support[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]We want players to feel connected to these islands in as many ways as possible. One of them would be offering a high level of customization for everyone to express themselves out of the box. Crafting a robust Mod Support system is the first step to offering such creative freedom. Our team has been working hand-on-hand with the modders over Discord, providing them with documentation, work tools and test mods to be used as examples. Together, we made great progress these days![/p][p align="justify"]If you are interested in [b]creating mods[/b] for Tinkerlands, please make sure that you [b]join our Discord community[/b] [i](link at the end of this post)[/i] as that will be the place to get help for now. If you are only interested in [b]playing mods[/b], we'd also ask you to join our [b]Discord server [/b]as that will be the hub to post mods until we’re ready to move this feature to Steam’s workshop.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Volcanic Island[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Play “floor is lava”, but… way less friendly? Better protect yourself, things are about to get BURNING HOT ([i]not in a good way[/i]). Explore this inferno in search of [b]unique items and more enemies to beat[/b]! The local fauna have adapted to the heat and they are [i]not[/i] happy to see you. But hey, with your [b]new weapons[/b] in hand, they might just warm up to you... violently.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/0aac4f3645016ff92e8c9c5483361bcc9cfd2c22.gif"][/img][/p][p]New land, new threats... naturally, you’ll need some new toys. Find powerful gear tailored to your favorite class: [b]Pyro Mage, Flame Warrior or Fireproof Archer[/b]. Choose your flavor of destruction![/p][p]Last but not least, an ash-tounding final fight against the [b]Magma Worm[/b] awaits you in the depths of the volcano… if you can handle the heat. No need for thumpers for these absolute units.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/e277cc31253a88ed69904e692a5ce3844cb188d4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Pet System[/b][/h2][p]Life would be so empty and horrible without animals by our side… so we squeezed in a [b]Pet System[/b] into this update! From the noble cat to a vivacious rock, find all sorts of cute creatures all over the map, foster them and they’ll love you back. In their own weird way.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/50540cef2acceff26cedbafb1be9fbce9b2930ed.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]PVP System[/b][/h2][p]Did your best friend steal the last slice of your favorite pizza? Some offenses need appropriate retribution. Enable [b]Friendly Fire[/b] and settle things the old-fashioned way–by hitting each other ruthlessly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/8838ca48982937487badecd66ab190a08612a61a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Banner System[/b][/h2][p]Say “NOPE” to that one mob you really hate! Now you can [b]craft special banners[/b] (yes, we do have a talent for naming things) to [i]banish[/i] certain especially annoying types of enemies and take tactical control of your surroundings.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/ecb22400d1ece91b2544d2c389240292dbbf6a44.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1][p]But wait, there’s more. For those interested in learning about all the new stuff, quality of life improvements and bug fixes, we’ve recently posted our Patch Notes in a separate article \[[url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2617700/view/545620341180859717"]link[/url]]. As we’ve spent the last two weeks testing features and identifying issues within Patch 0.2.0.0, there’s a lot to say this time–don’t let that list intimidate you! [/p][p]
[/p][p]That’s all for today, fellas. Remember to join our Discord server to discuss our latest updates, ask questions, report bugs, and find new co-op partners. And, of course, enjoy your adventure in the Tinkerlands. We lava you! ❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥 [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/bf995a40a59bc50fb11b3cf555d3f30b73e5fe39.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Volcanic & Mod Support Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/61a5fe7034d699309d9287befbbc2237aabb7323.png"][/img][/p][h2]Hey there, Tinkerlanders![/h2][p]Say hello to the [b]Volcanic & Mod Support Update[/b] - a fiery little bundle of features to spice up your Tinkerlands adventures. Apart from the new Volcano Island, this update adds pets, the new banner system and the first version of the modding support. Let's dive in:[/p][p][/p][h2]Unstable Branch[/h2][p][b]Tinkerlands v0.2.0.0 update[/b] introduces [b]mod support[/b] for the first time, and in order to make this work we had to [b]rebuild roughly a ~30% of the whole game[/b]. This means that things that worked correctly before might not work properly in this update, and we might have introduced new issues in places that worked before. We've done extensive QA and tests to avoid these issues, but we are still a small team and we might've missed things.

For this reason, we are introducing the [b]unstable[/b] [b]branch [/b]where you'll be able to play the newest version of the game a bit earlier, with the risk of some issues appearing. This [b]v0.2.0.0[/b] will be released initially in the [b]unstable branch[/b] for a few weeks until we can polish all the rough edges and be sure that everything is working correctly. [/p][p][/p][p]In order to join the [b]unstable branch[/b] you need to:[/p][olist][*][p]Right click [b]Tinkerlands[/b] on your library.[/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]Properties[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Betas[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]unstable[/b] from the dropdown list.[/p][/*][*][p]Tinkerlands will now automatically update to the unstable version.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]We [b]strongly recommend[/b] that you backup your files before playing in the unstable branch. You can find Tinkerlands save files in [b]AppData/Local/Tinkerlands[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]The unstable branch should be [i]stable enough [/i]as we've fixed every issue we've been able to find, so don't hesitate to give it a go![/p][p][/p][h2]Mod Support[/h2][p]Although this is just the start of the [b]modding support[/b], we've tried to make it as solid as possible. But since this is the earliest access to the mod support, we'll be working hand-on-hand with the modders over Discord, providing documentation, the tools and releasing some test mods to be used as examples.[/p][p][/p][p]If you are interested in [b]creating mods[/b] for Tinkerlands, please make sure that you [b]join our Discord community[/b] [i](link at the end of this post)[/i] as that will be the place to share mods, documentation, tools and get help for now.[/p][p][/p][p]If you are only interested in [b]playing mods[/b], we'd also ask you to join our [b]Discord community[/b] [i](link at the end of this post)[/i] as that will be the hub to post mods until the mod support is solid enough that we move to Steam's workshop.[/p][p][/p][h2]Volcanic Island[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/9a107af2dda9a624cc78ea4e88415cdaa4983ffd.gif"][/img][/p][p]Remember that old classic - "the floor is lava"? Yeah. We made it real. Introducing a brand-new island: a burning hot inferno filled with [b]new enemies[/b], [b]new items[/b], and [b]a whole lot of danger[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/772109f620dd6a00f89224a096a691f248cae97a.gif"][/img][/p][p]The local creatures have adapted to the heat and they are [i]not[/i] happy to see you. But hey, with your new weapons in hand, they might just warm up to you... violently.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/0aac4f3645016ff92e8c9c5483361bcc9cfd2c22.gif"][/img][/p][p]Face off against the Magma Worm if you can handle the heat. No need for thumpers for these absolute units.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/c5261da9978b239841a35d7cb86543c086cac47d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]New land, new threats... naturally, you’ll need some new toys. Find powerful gear tailored to your favorite class: Pyro Mage, Flame Warrior or Fireproof Archer 🔥 It’s up to you to choose your flavor of destruction![/p][p][/p][h2]Banner System[/h2][p]“Banner” as in [i]ban[/i] - and yes, we do have a talent for naming things. Now you can craft [b]special banners[/b] to [i]banish[/i] certain especially annoying types of enemies. Use them wisely and take tactical control of your surroundings - or just enjoy the satisfaction of saying “nope” to that one mob you really hate.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/ecb22400d1ece91b2544d2c389240292dbbf6a44.png"][/img][/p][h2]PvP System[/h2][p]Need to teach your friend a lesson? Or just feeling a bit competitive? Enable [b]Friendly Fire[/b] and settle things the old-fashioned way - by hitting each other ruthlessly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/75d12b622bf8527d93acf96f6e0f8010103c5a08.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Pet System[/h2][p]We know you love cuteness. So we squeezed in a [b]Pet System[/b] into this update! Сollect them and show them your love - and they’ll love you back (in their own weird way).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/4ac63014d8205bf31296cb63702016bb7ec44e3d.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That’s it for now, Tinkerlanders![/p][p]Hop into the [b]unstable branch[/b], play around, break things, and tell us what you think! Your feedback is lava to us 🔥[/p][p]

notes.title: Tinkerlands' Roadmap is here!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/525955857dbb83768d69eb3ce20e1dc6af325b5d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Roadmap[/h1][p]You've asked for it, and we've been a bit slow on delivering to be honest, but It's finally here! These are the main features we are going to be working on during Tinkerlands' Early Access, and as stated in the image, the content added throughout the Early Access is not limited to the roadmap and changes may occur at any point during development.

This roadmap only contains the major features we have planned, but we will also be working on other minor features, quality of life, suggestions and more. So without further ado, check out the brand-new [b]Tinkerlands' roadmap[/b] for the [b]Early Access[/b]:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/a2ecd7e78c4ad61b09474c4bf354459426cb3ac3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]v0.2.0.0 — Mod Support Update[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/029e3be9c1c0d51ba122ace427626548c5d24207.png"][/img][/p][p]We have talked about this before, but we can finally confirm that [b]Mod Support[/b] will be coming to Tinkerlands as part of the first roadmap milestone. We plan to develop [b]Mod Support[/b] by working together with the community, so we can cover all that should be needed to develop mods, and even though this will be first available in this update, we will continue developing this feature throughout the whole Early Access Period.

This update will also include a new major island with a [b]Volcanic[/b] theme, where you'll need to find a way to travel through lava rivers and fight enormous lava worms.[/p][p][/p][p]Not enough? Cool, this update will also include a few new systems that we are already working on, like what we've called "[b]Enemy Banners[/b]" where you'll be able to craft enemy-specific banner objects that you will be able to place, to vanish that enemy from existence (meaning that they won't naturally spawn anymore in a radius). This will allow the creation of natural mob farms, and will also allow you to do some fishing without those snow wolves coming after you.

Also, [b]Pets and PVP[/b] are coming. I don't think I need to explain these features, but you'll be able to explain a couple of things to your friends once PVP is enabled.[/p][p][/p][h2]v0.3.0.0 — Town & NPCs Update[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/b45d079cd32610a39178dc82124da73b3508aaf4.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've heard your feedback about the [b]NPCs[/b], so we went bananas with them. In this update the settlement will come to life, and enemies will try to end it by invading your home. Settlements will require a central object in order to be built, and this object will need to be upgraded in order to make the settlement grow, be able to invite more [b]NPCs[/b], and unlock some of the new [b]NPCs[/b] functionality.

And speaking about [b]NPCs[/b] functionality, we know, [b]NPCs[/b] are definitely non-playable, but saying that they are characters might not be a 100% correct term, since they are more akin to stationary shops. This update will take care of that, and [b]NPCs[/b] will unlock lots of new features including but not limited to: Being combat capable, having life (no more invulnerable [b]NPCs[/b]), perform tasks (small scale automation), interact with other npcs and objects and a friendship system that we will talk more about in the future.

But that's not all folks! This update will also include new major islands (we'll discuss them in the future), and also new systems like mounts and a lot of new stuff for the cable system, including world-made and player-made traps.[/p][p][/p][h2]v0.4.0.0 — Endless Tower Update[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/f92d6ad587ddca8e6720261df0f9089aeec45ec2.png"][/img][b][i](Sneak peek from Volcano Island, not related to the Endless Tower, but I had to put an image here)[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is something that we've been wanting to add for a long, long time! The new [b]Endless Tower[/b] will be an island that will be accessible at some point in the game. [b]Endless Tower[/b] is a dungeon where the player will have to go up a certain number of floors, which each floor being randomly generated with enemies and traps. Players will get new items each floor and will have to use them to further progress into the tower.

[i]- That's a Roguelike.[/i]

Yes, yes... but you'll get cool rewards that can be used outside the [b]Endless Tower[/b], what about that?!

Once again, we'll explain more about this feature in the future. And this update will also include a new island (pirate themed, how cool is that?) and new systems, like the new Statue Fuel system, where you'll be able to "fuel" statues (and other stuff) that spawn enemies so they drop goodies. And where you'll be able to use items that you don't want anymore to create this fuel. [/p][p][/p][h2]v1.0.0.0 — Navigation & Finale Update[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/985d916f6f10b116d403d98d2b6655097e09c9d1.png"][/img][b][i](We will be saying goodbye to this fella in this update...)[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Finally the finale. Every story needs to end at some point, and this is the point where Tinkerlands (story) ends. This will include the final location of the game and the final boss. Not much to say about this, so I'll instead talk about the othe major feature of this update: Navigation Overhaul![/p][p]
Right now, the ship acts as a loading zone between the main island and the destination island, but we don't want to do that. So in this update, you'll be able to travel between islands [b]physically[/b]. That means that you'll be fighting enemies [b]while you travel to the next island[/b], managing the ship resources and using the ship facilities to defend it from enemies and random events.

What ship facilities you say? Well, the ones that you will need to build of course. This update will remove the prefab ship we have right now, and will introduce true ship building, where you'll need to place each part of the ship to create the design of your dreams. [i]Just don't share them with us If they are NSFW[/i].[/p][p][/p][h1]And that's about it![/h1][p]Thank you so much for reading up to here, and for being our partner in this journey and for your support. I couldn't end this post without saying thank you. If you want to stay tuned on the latest new, ask the team some questions, share suggestions or bug reports, please consider joining the [b]Discord community[/b]. [/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/bf995a40a59bc50fb11b3cf555d3f30b73e5fe39.png"][/img][/h2]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/f5d13b14e6ce6d1fb92668f24dd3f98ce067497a.png[/img]

Hello everybody!

We’re back once again with a new update, addressing some of the most common bugs reported so far. It looks like our save corruption system had a few holes — which should now be fixed.

This time, our major focus has been on fixing as many bugs as possible. We've also addressed some balance issues and quality-of-life requests. We'll keep working on these updates until all bugs are resolved and the game's balance reaches a state we're happy with. Meanwhile, the rest of the team is already working on future content.

And speaking of future content — we’ve been getting questions about it non-stop lately, and yes, we will be publishing a roadmap for the Early Access content [b]very soon[/b]. [i]Spoiler: Mod support is included in the roadmap[/i].

Thank you once again for your support and understanding. We’re a small team with only one programmer, and we can’t fix everything as fast as we’d like to. 🙏

[h2]Enemy spawn rates under our radar[/h2]
We've noticed a couple of bugs regarding enemy spawn rates, and by fixing them the enemy spawn rate got too low. We've been tweaking the numbers to make them fair and consistent to players, but It may need further tweaking in the next update. Please share with us how you feel about the enemy spawn rates!

One of these bugs was dividing the enemy spawn timer by two every time the player changed a "chunk", which is something that occurs very frequently when moving around. This meant that enemies would spawn much faster than intended, and that items that modify the enemy spawn rates (talisman, swarm potion, etc) wouldn't work properly, or at all.

[h2]Tinkerlands v0.1.4.0[/h2]
- You can now switch between Windowed, Fullscreen, and Borderless Fullscreen modes.
- You can now switch between game-level and OS-level mouse input.
- The player now slides off object edges.
- Updated English/Spanish localization for "The Nurse" / "La enfermera".
- Buffed the items "Sanctification" and "Soul Reaper."
- Reduced the mining power required to break Desert Bones.
- Blood Slimes and Blood Biome interactables now provide Blood Essence.
- Increased the spawn rate of Peridot in the Jungle.
- Spider walls can now be mined with the Omnitool.
- Items can no longer be reforged back to <Normal> quality.
- Items that do not consume MP will no longer receive MP-related affixes when reforged.
- Torches placed in the second quickbar slot now emit light.
- The Hoe can now be used on dirt.
- The Frog Prince Altar now includes a guaranteed teleport point.
- Cave entrances now include a guaranteed teleport point.
- The teleport cutscene is now faster.
- Gamepad cursor now functions correctly when zoom level is increased.
- Buffs can now be removed by right-clicking them.
- Pumpkin, Goblin, and Trichroma Islands are now less rare.
- Increased the lighting radius of torches.
- Event end notifications no longer duplicate for each player.
- Coral Door can now be broken.
- "Curse of the Swamp" notifications no longer duplicate for each player.
- "Curse of the Desert" notifications no longer duplicate for each player.
- Coins can now be picked up even if the inventory is full.
- Added the missing sound effect for the Medic's heal ability.
- The Medic's heal now has a 30-second cooldown.
- Swarm Potion spawn rate increased from 300% to 500%.
- Flippers’ drop rate from enemies increased from 1% to 3%.
- Flippers are now a guaranteed drop on the Main Island.
- Updated the bomb icon.
- Many localization typos fixed.
- Fixed a typo in the Ankh's description.
- Updated the in-game name of "Liana."
- Corrected the Spanish description localization for the Necronomicon and Death Note.
- Removed an extra pressure plate from one of the Jungle structures.
- Balanced Jungle enemy AI.
- Fixed an issue where enemy spawn rate increased when the player moved around.
- Fixed a crash related to Electrician quests.
- Fixed a bug that allowed players to buy items even if they didn’t appear in the shop.
- Fixed a bug where players could buy extra items without paying for them.
- Fixed incorrect sprites on the Goblin Wall.
- Fixed a bug that occurred when being killed by a worm enemy underground.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when opening certain chests.
- Fixed an issue where corrupted data was not being properly detected.
- Fixed a crash that happened when dashing with spores equipped.
- Fixed inconsistencies in the capitalization of HP and MP.

Hello everybody!

First of all, I want to give a huge thanks to all of you for playing our game, and supporting us. It's been overwhelming seeing so many of you having fun and sharing doubts and knowledge about the game. We also received over 500 tickets and we are checking every single one of them, It's gonna take some time but we are going to make sure that they are all processed.

We have already collected the most common ones, and we are working towards applying them, starting with this first patch.

[h2]Tinkerlands v0.1.1.0[/h2]
[h3]Locked mouse to the game's framerate[/h3] 
This sounds like a bad change, but we suspect this might be the cause for the silent crashes some people are experiencing. We'll investigate further from here and will find an alternative way to detach the cursor from the game's framerate, but It's better to do something about it while we investigate the issue. If you get a silent crash after updating, please let us know!

[h3]Fixed an issue that would duplicate the Enemy Director, making it spawn more enemies each time[/h3]
This was an oversight on our end, every time you travel to a different island, the enemy director had a chance to duplicate itself. This meant that enemy spawn rates were increasing every time you travelled.

[h3]Tuned down aggro from enemies in Jungle and Pumpking islands[/h3]
Some monsters aggro range was excessive, making it look like they are spawning non-stop (which was also related to the bug above this) but It was a matter of enemies following the player forever and from very afar.

[h3]Increased Stack Sizes[/h3]
We've heard your feedback. Most of the misc and building items stack sizes have been increased to 99 and 999. We also have plans to add bigger containers in the near future.

[h3]Fullscreen mode is now borderless[/h3]
This was an issue specially for players that have different text input methods, where they would get thrown out of the game while typing. This change should avoid this issue entirely.

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
It's still early to make big balance changes, but we've been hearing (and enjoying) your suffering. But in order to make some things less painful, we've added new recipes for better HP/MP potions, aswell as reduced the time it takes for fishes to escape. Also, enemies won't be doing more critical damage to players.

[h3]Full list of changes[/h3]
- Locked mouse to the game's framerate.
- Fixed an issue that would duplicate the Enemy Director, making it spawn more enemies each time.
- Tuned down aggro from enemies in Jungle and Pumpking islands.
- Increased stack sizes.
- Fullscreen mode changed to borderless fullscreen.
- Enemies should no longer do crit damage.
- Fishes now escape a bit more slowly.
- Fixed an issue that could corrupt worlds if auto-save triggered mid travelling.
- Fixed Jungle ruins block having their mining power too high.
- Added new recipes for HP and MP potion upgrades that don't require fishing.
- Made HP and MP potion upgrades available one tier before.

If you’ve played the prologue before, you might run into the "Error in action number 1" crash when launching the game. Don’t worry—it just means Steam cloud trying to load some older game files. To fix it, [b]head over to %appdata%/Roaming/Shipwrecked/players and delete the player files[/b].

notes.title: Q&A: Your questions answered!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/382e7cf413d717878f8156ef99ade00bc12551ed.png[/img]

[h2]Hey Tinkerlanders!🌴[/h2]

We can’t thank you enough for your continued support and interest in our tiny game 🥰 We've heard all your questions loud and clear! In this article, we've gathered the most common inquiries and provided detailed answers straight from our development team. Let's delve into the info you've been waiting for!

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/a390b5c72d97290ceab129de97ad7c9826180671.png[/img]


[h3]1. When is the Early Access version going to be released? [/h3]

We plan the Early Access version on Q1-Q2 2025, but we’ll also release a [b]demo with some new mechanics in October 2024[/b]. Make sure to wishlist the main game and [url=https://discord.com/invite/ES2UvUrtdR]join our Discord[/url] to stay tuned! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2617700/Tinkerlands/


[h3]2. Do you plan to add multiplayer mode? How many concurrent players can play it? Will there be some sort of map sharing for multiplayer?[/h3]

Yes. Co-Op multiplayer is planned for the Early Access version. We also don’t have plans to limit the amount of players that can play at the same time.

Map sharing is definitely going to be a feature. Players will be able to create, find or buy a map, and all other players can jump into the same ship and navigate to the given island.


[h3]3. What's the planned price for the Early Access version? [/h3]

The price isn’t decided yet, but we know for sure the Early Access version is going to be cheaper than the Full version of the game 


[h3]4. Will there be any further content updates to the prologue?[/h3]

We’re going to release one more patch note closing all the remaining issues this week. After that we will switch to the development of the Early Access version. But there’s going to be a free public demo with some new mechanics released in October 2024!


[h3]5. Is OST going to be available for downloading? [/h3]

We have plans to release the full OST along with the EA version. It is a bit too early at the moment, as it is most likely going to change over the full game’s development.


[h3]6. Is Codemanu a solo dev or are the others also developers?[/h3]

- CodeManu does all the programming and tool developing for the game, also leading the team, managing production, community and many other things 😵‍💫
- Karv is the artist and made 99% of the pixel art. The other 1% are most likely placeholders that CodeManu did and forgot to remove.
- DonutDroid is the sound designer, he made the whole OST (except for Town and Boss themes that CodeManu made) and the sounds of the game.
- Tashirotsu assist other team members and helps with game design, the idea of the snow biome damaging the player was his, you know who to hate now


[h3]7. Where is the team located?[/h3]

We’re located in Spain. ¡Hola! 🙂


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/6f43708a8268782a70cc0dfdd9b31554d6a5eb5e.png[/img]


[h3]1. Will there be a mob invasion mechanic in the future? For example like the army of the old man in Terraria [/h3]

Mob invasion/raids are a super fun mechanic that we are definitely going to look into it. We did have an invasion system early in development but ended up disabling it because It wasn’t very fun and we wanted to rework it in the future.


[h3]2. Are there going to be character customization and female avatars? [/h3]

Absolutely, player’s will be able to customize their characters on creation. They will also be able to further customize them with in-game items and NPCs.


[h3]3. Is there going to be any modding system in the game? Will it be system-wise level of changes(like skyrim mods), or limiting to just graphics/basic items?[/h3]

It is hard to answer before the game is fully completed, but yes, we do have plans to support modding. Our plans include the release of our internal tools that handle things like: Items, Interactables, Enemies, NPCs, AI, Structures, Island Generation and much more.


[h3]4. I'd like to know if there going to be more building options in the full release. Are there going to be any decorations and furniture for the houses? [/h3]

Yes! Karv, our artist, have actually already made different decorations and included different rotations. We didn’t have time to include them in the prologue but they are definitely coming to the full game.


[h3]5. Will it be possible to plant trees and do gardening in the game? [/h3]

Yes, farming is one of the side-activities we have planned for Tinkerlands.


[h3]6. When the game releases/future updates, will saves on the demo be valid? Or be able to be put into the main game's folder to be used?[/h3]

No, progress from the Prologue will not be carried over to the full game. This is a design decision, as the prologue is a different instance of the game and has a different progression path.


[h3]7. Any sort of pets/minions in the full game?[/h3]

Yes, we do already have minions/summons in the full game, and we also plan to add support for pets.


[h3]8. Will there be Colony-type stuff? Will there be more things townspeople can do? Like tending to crops, chopping wood, etc. Basically doing some chores for the player.[/h3]

Yes, and no. NPCs will be expanded in the full game with more functionality, however, we don’t have plans for NPCs to “work” for the player and we see them as an extension of the player’s toolkit.


[h3]9. Do you plan more accessory combinations for the Early Access version? [/h3]

Oh yeah! We have a list with hundreds of accessories ideas in our backlog. The final number will vary of course, as some of these ideas might not be viable (or just broken, we tend to go way too far). 


[h3]10. Will you add more villagers?[/h3]

Yes! We want you to build a big town with lots of different inhabitants, not a small settlement. We might have to say good-bye to some of the Prologue’s NPCs as their role might not be necessary anymore (looking at you Bard).


[h3]11. I want to know if there will be balance adjustments to the currency system and bombs in the official version?[/h3]

Yes. We didn’t want to have a tight economy in the Prologue, so players didn’t feel like they needed to grind for money, but that’s a different story for the full game. 


[h3]12. Will the full game have more smooth biome transition, either with existing biomes or with using biomes sub variants, just it feels bit weird to have hot desert bordering with freezing winter wasteland[/h3]

We will kindly ask the biome generation to be smoother. The biome generation tends to not listen to us however.


[h3]13. Any plans to add a summoner loadout?[/h3]

Yes, although they’ll be more of a variation of the mage class, rather than a class on their own.

__________________________

That's it for now! If you have more questions or just want to chat, feel free to reach out anytime. Don't forget to join our Discord community to stay in the loop with all the latest updates and hang out with fellow players.

notes.title: Meet the Team Behind Tinkerlands!
notes.notes:
Hello, Adventurers! 

We're excited to let you know that we're diligently crafting Tinkerlands, and [b]a free prologue is on its way to you soon[/b]! But as it is swiftly making its way to you, we thought it would be fantastic to introduce ourselves and give you a glimpse into our approach to crafting the magical world of Tinkerlands.

[h1]So, who are we?[/h1]

We go by the name Endless Coffee, and there are just three of us pouring our hearts and souls into making Tinkerlands a reality.

First up, we have Manuel, or as he's better known online, Codemanu. With a background primarily in programming since 2003, Manuel brings a wealth of experience to the table. But don't let that fool you - he's also a wizard when it comes to pixel art and music. Crafting games has been his passion for over two decades, and Tinkerlands is the culmination of that dream.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44666338/d72507e03811f39b756c325d2cdba2dd59ec78f6.jpg[/img]

Next, meet Carlos, also known as Karv. He's the artistic genius behind Tinkerlands, responsible for bringing its vibrant world to life. While he dabbled in programming and game design early on, it was his knack for pixel art that truly set his soul on fire. With a portfolio boasting titles like Hoppy Hop, Rogue Voltage, and 9 Years of Shadows, Carlos injects Tinkerlands with his unique creative flair.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44666338/029692cff6828e445745647f4fe9008bc2a6753d.png[/img]

Last but certainly not least, we have Jacob, aka DonutDroid, the maestro behind the mesmerizing music of Tinkerlands. A seasoned guitarist with over two decades of experience, Jacob's journey into the world of video game music began four years ago. With a passion for gaming spanning three decades, his musical compositions add depth and atmosphere to every corner of Tinkerlands.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44666338/c3474d4e19011f332d67ebbb516dc56c1b9d9adc.jpg[/img]

As a team, we're having an absolute blast building this world and sprinkling it with all sorts of little secrets for you to uncover. So gear up, fellow adventurers, because the journey awaits in Tinkerlands!

Join us on this magical adventure!

notes.title: Tinkerlands: Brand New Visuals, Gameplay Updates & Co-op Mode!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Long time no see 🙂
Hope you all had a great Christmas and New Year!

Meanwhile, we worked hard on our two upcoming projects: [b]Tinkerlands[/b] and its prologue - [b]A Shipwrecked Adventure[/b]. And now, in our second monthly ([i]well, not really monthly, but we will try to keep to that schedule![/i]) devlog, we want to share some updates with you!

Let's get started!

[b][h2]Updated Visuals and UI[/h2][/b]
The most significant improvement is the art style. We've received a lot of feedback from the Reddit and Twitter communities, and we've taken some notes on how to make the game look great!

Let's take a look at some of the changes to the overall art style and UI:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/c7d9e171bf54755dbbb5ba999a7a510f9907e1e7.png[/img]

We also started to make the gameplay more complex and the walkthrough more complicated ([i]not a grind wall, don’t worry![/i]) 

We decided to create some conditions to go to other locations but in a logical & more realistic way. For example, you will need to wear special light clothes for the Desert adventure. Otherwise, you will get some hallucinations and the sun can heat your head!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/fcd75459223149b7d7628a9348fd94ef4da90085.gif[/img]

[b][h2]First Steps into the Online[/h2][/b]
And we have some brand new stuff about the online mode! Let's have a look at the WIP video examples:

And yes, you can also do the [b]GET OVER HERE[/b] thing with it :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666338/293c416f90641e54d4e7cf9bc026fc0dda6295e5.gif[/img]

That's it for now, folks!
We've got a lot of work to do :)
Thank you for your attention <3

See you in a month (or more)!

Cheers,
The CodeManu Team
